meta.title: Digex | Digital agency in Algeria — branding, websites, content
meta.description: Digex Agency: brand identity, online stores and marketing content for Algerian brands.

hero.headline: Your brand deserves
hero.sub: Brand identity, an online store that sells, content that lands — one team, from the idea to the first sale.

problem.title: In Algeria, the product isn't the problem. <mark>Visibility</mark> is.
problem.lead: A good product with weak branding stays invisible. That's exactly what we fix.

items.title: An identity that doesn't set you apart
items.body: A rushed logo and random colours make you look like every competitor.

items.title: Customers who pass through and never return
items.body: They find you on Facebook, can't find where to buy, and leave.

items.title: A slow site — or no site at all
items.body: Or a store that breaks on mobile, where 90% of your customers are browsing.

items.title: Content with no direction
items.body: Scattered posts with no visual thread build no memory of your brand.

services.title: Everything your brand needs, under one <mark>roof</mark>
services.lead: Eight connected services. No more coordinating four freelancers.

deliverables.graphicElements: The full set of graphic elements

branding.title: <mark>Branding</mark> and brand creation
branding.tagline: A brand is more than a logo
branding.body: A brand is a vision, a promise, an experience. Our strategic approach covers market research, target audience, positioning, customer experience, vision and values, and strategic planning.

visualIdentity.title: Visual <mark>identity</mark>
visualIdentity.tagline: Build a brand that leaves a mark
visualIdentity.body: We design a coherent, memorable brand world aligned with your values and your audience. From the logo to every graphic element, we turn your name into an identity that is strong, recognisable and worth remembering.

digitalMarketing.title: <mark>Digital marketing</mark> and social media
digitalMarketing.tagline: Present where your audience already is
digitalMarketing.body: We put your brand at the centre of the platforms your audience actually uses. Strategy built on data, content worth stopping for, and properly run channels turn your digital presence into real growth and lasting loyalty.

digitalSolutions.title: Digital <mark>solutions</mark>
digitalSolutions.tagline: An online presence that serves your goals
digitalSolutions.body: Without a digital presence, a business loses customers and visibility. Showcase sites, search-ready online stores wired to payment and delivery, landing pages — plus the ERP and networked storage that run the business behind them.

printing.title: Professional <mark>printing</mark>
printing.body: Print built for every need, large format to small. Roll-ups, banners, large posters and tarpaulins for events and storefronts; business cards, flyers, brochures and catalogues for the everyday work of presenting your business.

packaging.title: <mark>Packaging</mark> and labels
packaging.tagline: Strong packaging attracts, tempts and convinces
packaging.body: With creative, strategic design your product stands out on the shelf, strengthens your brand image and lifts your sales.

interiorExterior.title: <mark>Interior</mark> and exterior design
interiorExterior.tagline: A space that tells your brand's story
interiorExterior.body: From the facade to the interior layout, every element reflects your identity. Exterior signage, storefronts, space planning, furniture, lighting and atmosphere turn your premises into a real visual extension of your brand.

photoVideo.title: <mark>Photography</mark> and video
photoVideo.tagline: We tell your brand through the lens
photoVideo.body: From product shoots to social video, promotional films and reels: professional visual content, art-directed to sit consistently with your visual identity.

pricing.title: Packages
pricing.lead: Price depends on scope. Tell us what you need and we'll send you a precise quote.

process.title: Five <mark>clear</mark> stages, no surprises
process.lead: You always know where your project stands and what happens next.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.body: We sit down with you: your business, your customers, your competitors. You leave with a written brief.

steps.title: Identity
steps.body: We set the visual direction — logo, colours, type — and lock it before a single line of code.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: We develop the site or store, produce the content, and prepare print in parallel.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: We test everything on mobile, connect analytics and payments, and go live.

steps.title: Support
steps.body: We stay after launch: updates, campaigns, and tracking the numbers.

work.title: Projects we <mark>shipped</mark> — you can visit them right now
work.lead: Every project here is real and live. Click through and judge for yourself.

proof.title: Brands that <mark>trust</mark> us
proof.lead: Algerian brands we've taken from identity through to launch.
